gate_title: Sacrificial Calibration Pilot V4.1 Relational Contrast Difficulty & Discrimination Gate Specification

governing_laws.primary_outcome: PAIRWISE_RELATIONAL_SUCCESS (Primary outcome variable is pairwise relational discrimination success).
governing_laws.primary_scoring_rule: A pair succeeds for an arm iff: (1) Verdict A equals preregistered target A; (2) Verdict B equals preregistered target B; and (3) the observed verdict transition equals the preregistered A->B transition.
governing_laws.secondary_diagnostic: EVIDENCE_FIDELITY_DIAGNOSTIC (Observational record assessing whether citations accurately reflect scenario facts without claiming an unchanged fact was altered. Retained for post-hoc qualitative audit; does NOT alter primary binary pair-success scoring).
governing_laws.isolation_law: PILOT_ITEM != INFERENTIAL_ITEM (Pilot items are sacrificial; responses never enter main inferential data).
governing_laws.treatment_freeze_law: PILOT_CALIBRATION != TREATMENT_OPTIMIZATION (Treatments K0, K0D, K1, K2, K3 remain frozen and unoptimized).

anti_floor_rule.requirement: Baseline arm (K0 or K0D) must achieve >= 1/5 (20%) pair discrimination success, ensuring prompt instructions and task formatting are parseable and solvable.

anti_ceiling_rule.requirement: A single arm may achieve 5/5 pair discrimination success if comparator profiles differ. Ceiling failure occurs if and only if the key comparator set saturates such that the assay cannot distinguish K0D, K1, and K2: (K0D = 5/5 AND K1 = 5/5 AND K2 = 5/5).

methodological_identification_rule.requirement: Pair-transition success profiles across the 5 pairs cannot be identical across K0D, K1, and K2. There must be non-zero pairwise variance between at least two arms among {K0D, K1, K2} (profile(K0D) != profile(K1) or profile(K1) != profile(K2)).
methodological_identification_rule.failure_disposition: HOLD (classification: METHODOLOGICALLY_NON_IDENTIFYING; assay cannot separate conventional engineering from Aperture from matched baseline).

pairwise_spread_rule.requirement: Success variance must not be driven by a single isolated pair. At least 2 of the 5 construct pairs must exhibit non-zero across-arm variance in pair discrimination success.

dynamic_range_rule.requirement: Total successful pair evaluations across all 5 arms must span between 5 and 20 out of 25 possible evaluations (20% to 80% dynamic range).

consequence_of_gate_failure.custody_rule: Amari remains sole SCIENTIFIC_CONTROLLER / SCORER / ADJUDICATOR. Gate review and adjudication must be confirmed before any main execution authorization.
